problem: The canonical GitHub Pages origin is blocked by CORS when the 11520 browser calls api.binance.com, leaving all three market cards at WAIT.
decision: Use Binance's documented public market-data-only origin, request only the canonical KX/KY/KZ symbols, and accept only a complete validated atomic quote set.
acceptance: The quote origin is fixed to https://data-api.binance.vision and cannot be caller-overridden.
The request is credential-free GET with no Authorization header and no redirect following.
BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT and BNBUSDT must all be finite and positive before state changes.
Malformed, incomplete, duplicate, HTTP-error and timeout responses fail closed.
A failed refresh preserves a previously validated quote set and visibly marks it STALE.
Real Chromium at 390x844 shows LIVE prices without a quote CORS error.
Production Pages source hashes match the merged main SHA and the production screenshot shows LIVE prices.
prohibited_effects: No API key, secret, signer, wallet authorization or paid API.
No order placement, settlement, payment, Mainnet transaction or chain-state mutation.
No Worker or Life activation, external agent launch, governance action or Canon rewrite.
merge_policy: Ready, mergeable, exact latest main, exact-head CI green, zero unresolved threads or blocking comments, expected_head_sha required
